Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_SunlightMultipli:
How much power solar panels make. The easiest way to make the mod easier or harder.
1 is Kentucky's real sunlight on these old modules: a module on a ground rack banks about 0.6 kWh on an average July day and 0.4 in December, and a fridge-freezer uses about 6 kWh a day, so it takes ten modules in summer and more than fifteen in winter.
At the default 2.5, four or five modules run it in summer and about seven in winter.
At 5, half that. Raise it if you'd rather not spend the game hunting for panels, or if you lower their loot.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_BiogasMultiplier:
How much gas digesters make from what you feed them. It doesn't change how long they take to start, how easily they sour or how fast they fill with sludge.
1 is what a real digester makes: at the game's default Generator Fuel Consumption, one cow's manure keeps a generator running a fridge-freezer most of the day, and a small herd runs a house.
Raise it if you keep only a pig or a few chickens, or play with a higher Generator Fuel Consumption.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_BatteryWear_tool:
How fast batteries wear out, as a percent of normal. Batteries wear from deep drains: one drained a quarter of the way every night lasts about four times as long as one drained halfway.
At 100, drained halfway every night, a car battery is down to half its capacity in about five months, a deep cycle in about a year and an L-16 in about two.
50 doubles those, 200 halves them, 0 turns wear off. Servicing, reconditioning and rebuilding still work at any setting.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_FailsafeStartCha:
A Solar Failsafe starts its generator when the battery bank's charge drops below this percent.
Lower runs the generator less often but drains the batteries deeper, which wears them faster. Keep it below Failsafe Stop Charge.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_FailsafeStopChar:
A Solar Failsafe stops its generator once the battery bank's charge reaches this percent.
Higher fills the bank fuller on each start, so the generator starts less often but runs longer. Without a charger wired into the bank, the generator only carries the load while it runs, and the charge climbs only as fast as the panels, wind chargers and treadmills fill it.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_SolarSites_toolt:
Percent chance that each of the map's set-up sites is there, rolled once when the world is created: off-grid farms, stock tank pumps, campers, phone company relay sheds, ranger stations, the power company yard, road works and army checkpoints with arrow board trailers, old wind farms, a dairy and a prepper's cabin.
The worn finds by barns, livestock buildings and hunting shacks turn up more or less often with it too.
100 puts in every site, 0 none of them and no finds. The road works north of Muldraugh and the checkpoint on the highway south of Louisville are always there unless this is 0.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_GardenLights_too:
Percent of the usual chance that a house has solar garden lights along its front walk, rolled once per house the first time someone sees it. Nicer neighbourhoods have more.
0 turns them off; 200 doubles them.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_LRMSolarPanels_t:
Multiplies how often solar modules spawn as loot: in containers, vehicles, the mod's crates of solar gear, beside the battery banks it places and on arrow board trailers. Cracked modules are common and good ones rare at 1.
It doesn't change the panels standing at solar sites.
0 turns them off, so you build your own from solar cells.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_LRMBatteries_too:
Multiplies how often deep cycle and L-16 batteries and battery electrolyte spawn as loot, in containers, vehicles and crates of solar gear, and how many batteries the battery banks the mod places hold.
Electrolyte can't be crafted, so at 0 the only acid for rebuilding batteries is in the ones you strip. Car batteries aren't affected.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_LRMMisc_tooltip:
Multiplies how often everything else the mod adds spawns as loot: inverters, charge controllers, solar battery maintainers and chargers, garden lights, the failsafe, car alternators, the Homestead Power magazines and the FEMA plans, in containers, vehicles, crates and placed battery banks; and how often a placed bank holds a car battery charger.
Inverters can't be crafted, so at 0 the only ones are in banks already standing in the world.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_ChargeFreq_toolt:
How often battery banks work out their charge and load.
Every Ten Minutes: power cut by an overload or an empty bank comes back within minutes of fixing it.
Every Hour: lighter on a busy server with many banks, but a cut can last up to an hour.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_BatteryBankSpawn:
How often sheds, garages, storage units and farm and electronics store storerooms hold a stocked battery box or rack, and garages and storage units a crate of RV solar gear, the first time someone sees them.
These give an early start without a skill or a magazine. None leaves you to build or find everything.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_StashMode_toolti:
Four stash houses hold a crate of solar gear, and more crates and shelves of panels and batteries.
Map items: each is marked on an annotated map you have to find first.
Random initial: most of them are stocked from the start, without a map.
Change it only when starting a new game.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_StashMode_option: Add map items and random initial
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_ConnectPanelMin_: In-game minutes it takes to connect one panel, wind charger or treadmill to a battery bank, before higher Electricity shortens it.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_StormDamage_tool:
Whether storms damage what stands outside.
Thunderstorms with strong wind crack solar modules, which then make less until you seal or reglaze them. Wall panels never crack; metal mounts crack least, wooden ground racks most.
Gales break the blades of wind chargers left running: plastic pipe blades first, then carved wood, then forged steel. The charger creaks and rattles first, and Set the Brake keeps it safe. A homebuilt wind turbine swings out of the wind and holds longer. The scoop rotor never breaks.
Off, nothing breaks in storms.
Sandbox_RenewableEnergy_StormDamageRate_:
Percent of the chance that a thunderstorm cracks a module or a gale breaks unbraked blades, when Storm Damage is on.
At 100, ten panels lose about one module every four to six months, and even two days of the strongest wind the game blows break the weakest blades only about one time in seven.
50 halves that, 200 doubles it.
